manual.title: Email Prof. Leiva: is a delayed 2027 start / near-completion acceptable?
manual.notes: Before preparing anything (deadline 2026-07-22): ask whether the selected candidate must have COMPLETED the MSc before the Oct-2026 start, or whether a delayed 2027 start / applying with the thesis near completion is possible. My research-based MSc is expected to finish July 2027. Only prepare materials if the timing is confirmed adjustable; otherwise keep as a high-value group to track and skip this round.
